entities.summary: Justus Hermanni Annunen, nicknamed "Juice" or "Big Juice", is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Colorado Avalanche in the third-round, 64th overall, of the 2018 NHL entry draft.
